case_title: MODE DIANE ELAINE VS BROWN LISA

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,233.97 FILED BY MODE DIANE ELAINE AS TO DEFENDANT BROWN LISA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-27-1990 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 02

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MODE DIANE ELAINE RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT BROWN LISA $933.97 PRINCIPAL, $12.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $945.97 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
